pending_commit.commit_message: faft: Update firmware_SoftwareSync to more general Update the firmware_SoftwareSync test: * Use AP reboot to trigger software sync, instead of EC reboot. * Use ectool to obtain the hash, instead of reading directly on the EC RW image. So it doesn't matter it is RW A or B. BUG=b:69921268 TEST=Ran the modified firmware_SoftwareSync on Soraka, non-EC-EFS. Change-Id: I2f0a5261ed1ce049d95ff867c5dd96d52bd887e9 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/817536 Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Reviewed-by: Daisuke Nojiri <dnojiri@chromium.org>

faft: Fix the creation of CBFS-working directory for unified builds The bios.bin is no longer in the root of the working directory. There are multiple model directories containing the bios.bin, like: bios.bin -> models/fizz/bios.bin The bios_path is now a related path, like models/fizz/bios.bin For working on the CBFS modification, should clone the entire directory, instead of the bios.bin file only. BUG=b:69921268 TEST=Call the cbfs methods on an unified-build-enabled device. Change-Id: I65a88eb1d433d2eb03fae9907d6f3b0b8e0a81e8 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/817538 Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Reviewed-by: Caveh Jalali <caveh@google.com> Reviewed-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@google.com>

faft: Support a different extension of CBFS chip component Support ecrw as a kind of chips (client/common_lib/cros/chip_utils.py) The CBFS component name for ecrw doesn't have an extenion, i.e. 'ecrw' instead of 'ecrw.bin'. So make the methods accepting an extension string as arguments. BUG=b:69921268 TEST=With the CLs following, run firwmare_ECUpdateId test. faft: Truncate CBFS after adding new components The 'cbfstool expand' command creates a new null component at the last entry, such that the new components can be added. After that, should call 'cbfs truncate' to remove the null component. BUG=b:69921268 TEST=With the CLs following, run firwmare_ECUpdateId test. baseboard-oak: Enable USE=vulkan We build the vk_glow test when USE=vulkan is enabled. We attempt to run vk_glow when libvulkan is present. libvulkan is present on Elm/Hana, but we don't build the vk_glow test. We then attempt to run the vk_glow test. Let's fix this. BUG=chromium:654131 TEST=emerge-elm drm-tests. vk_glow doesn't work on Elm due the fact it can't support XB24 for scanout. However, vk_glow doesn't render anything on Eve either so let's build it anyways until we figure what to do regard this test. login: Make EnableChromeTesting take environment vars. Update session_manager's EnableChromeTesting D-Bus method to take an additional (currently optional) argument listing environment variables that should be set before running Chrome. Unfortunately, D-Bus codegen doesn't support optional args, so this requires manually unmarshaling arguments from calls to this method until all callers have been updated. BUG=chromium:770562,chromium:793668 TEST=tests pass; also verified that method works both with and without env vars arg CQ-DEPEND=Ib65ead08400dc4af8c17040d3aa60e57b8295638 Change-Id: Ia1b7f030c2241c051233ccce38e1150a625f943a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/818737 Commit-Ready: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Tested-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mattias Nissler <mnissler@chromium.org>

grunt: servo overlay This gives us some initial settings for servo for Grunt. This reconfigures the warm_reset pin, as it's now on pin 39 (as it is on some other new boards). It also sets the Vref for the PCH SPI write-protect to 3.3V since that's the voltage everything else seems to use for signaling there. wpa_supplicant: build deps for EAP-SIM external processing Since we don't have smartcard support and no ebuilds supply pcsc-lite, the eap-sim USE flag will always cause us to fail trying to build wpa_supplicant. Instead of trying to build in EAP-SIM support using the smartcard libraries, let's assume it would be supported by an external processor using the control interface, so we should build those things instead. telemetry_runner: Add quotes for rsync command The rsync option over ssh was eaten by the ssh command which failed the rsync command for telemetry_Benchmark tests to copy the wprgo files to DUT via devserver. This patch fixes it with adding the quotes for the rsync command over ssh. BUG=chromium:793243 TEST=manual test with command with escape character added: ssh DEVSERVER_IP "rsync -L --delete --timeout=1800 --rsh='/usr/bin/ssh -a -x -o ControlPath=/tmp/_autotmp_qk913Mssh-master/socket -o Protocol=2 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=30 -o ServerAliveInterval=900 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -o ConnectionAttempts=4 -l root -p 22' -az --no-o --no-g PATH_OF_jetstream_000.wprgo \"DUT_IP:/usr/local/telemetry/src/tools/perf/page_sets/data/jetstream_000.wprgo\"" Change-Id: Ie61516d5ef4cd54a8fa70e9cefea73f7ce1b9e03 Signed-off-by: Chung-yih Wang <cywang@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/818590 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Reviewed-by: Ben Cheng <bccheng@chromium.org>
